notes: *every whit* is headed on *every* by rule 31's subtraction test, since *whit* alone names a mere particle and loses the totality lexeme; the alternative heading on *whit* as the phrase's content noun is defensible and is recorded here.
The marginal *as a whole burnt-offering* and *mound* are alternative renderings only and do not govern the alignment (rule 7).
תֵּל עוֹלָם → *a heap for ever* gives the recast construct relation *for* to the rectum under rule 19, headed on *ever*.
